entities.name: Michel Lévêque
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michel Lévêque is a French diplomat and politician. From 1997 to 2000 he was minister of state for Monaco. He was the French ambassador to Libya (1985–1989), Morocco (1991–1993), Brazil (1993–1994) and Algeria (1995–1997).
